provenance: The snapshot records the source response SHA-256, fetch timestamp and ETag. Only findspot IDs and site names are retained; duplicate and unknown memberships remain explicit.
replay: Supply --response-file, --fetched-at and --etag to reproduce a snapshot from the same saved raw response and metadata. sourceRevision checksums raw response bytes before projection.
knownSourceAmbiguity: Findspot ID 1 occurs with both null and Umma membership. No site assignment is inferred from that ambiguity.
